query: UPDATE discovery_sources SET canonical_uri=$2,capabilities=CASE WHEN 'peer_exploration'=ANY(capabilities) THEN ARRAY['source_inspection','video_catalogue','peer_exploration'] ELSE ARRAY['source_inspection','video_catalogue'] END,verified_at=clock_timestamp(),valid_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '24 hours',cooldown_until=NULL,last_success_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$1
